column1: # The State Department clerk's decipherment, written between the lines, of two short coded passages by Crawford on the
# same roll as the letter of 5 Nov 1814 (NARA RG 59, M34 roll 18, naId 188673229), set against the code tables.
# A check found after the reading of the 5 Nov letter was made (NOTES.md section 7); the decipherment is the clerk's of
# 1814, so nothing here is an independent solution.
#   M34-018-0025R: a private letter of mid-September 1814 (frames 0022-0028; its first page was not opened for the date);
#                  13 groups, in the code Weber numbers WE028, not WE025.
#   M34-018-0031R, M34-018-0032L: Crawford to Monroe, private, Paris, 26 Sept 1814 (the second figure of the day is
# Columns: frame and leaf (L/R); line = the line of code on that leaf, counted from the first line that carries groups
# ("lower" = a separate passage lower on the page); seq = running number within the letter; group_as_read = the number
# on the film; mark = Crawford's mark on the group; clerk_gloss_span = the word the clerk wrote above, with the groups it
# spans; table, table_value = the code and its element for that number; agrees = whether the element gives the clerk's
# word (yes with mark = through the mark shown).
# WE025: 66 of 68 agree with the table as we had transcribed it; the two others are 1181 (an error in our transcription;
# Weber's printed page agrees with the clerk) and a group ending in 70 whose first figure is blotted. WE028: 13 of 13.
# Transcribed from crops of the frames by an AI agent on 15 Nov 2026 with the clerk's words in view (not a blind
# transcription); a second AI agent re-read lines 3, 4 and 6 of 0031R, lines 3 and 4 of 0032L and both lines of 0025R
# on the film. No person has checked it.
